## Advanced Giant Scorpion (CR 4)

**XP** 800  
N Large vermin  
**Init** +0; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +4  
 

**Defense**

 
 **AC** 20, touch 11, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +9 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 65 (5d8+25)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +3, **Will** +3  
**Immune** mind-affecting effects  
 

**Offense**

 
 **Speed** 50 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +8 (1d6+6 plus grab), sting +8 (1d6+6 plus poison)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** constrict (1d6+6)  
 

**Statistics**

 
 **Str** 23, **Dex** 14, **Con** 20, Int—, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +10 (+14 grapple); **CMD** 22 (34 vs. trip)  
**Skills** Climb +10, Perception +6, Stealth +2; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Climb, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth  
 

**Special Abilities**

 
 **Poison (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save* Fort DC 17; *frequency* 1/round for 6 rounds; *effect* 1d2 Strength damage; *cure* 1 save. The save DC is Constitutuion-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.  
 
 **Grab**: If this creature hits with a claw attack, it deals 1d6+6 damage and attempts to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity. It may only grab Medium or smaller opponents. The centipede has the option to conduct the grapple normally, or simply use its claw to hold the opponent. If it chooses to do the latter, it takes a –20 penalty on its CMB check to make and maintain the grapple, but does not gain the grappled condition itself. A successful hold does not deal any extra damage.  
 


**Ecology**

 
**Environment** warm or temperate deserts, forests, plains, or underground  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
